Overview

Kenosha is a city in WI with a population of 100,000. Southeastern Wisconsin city on Lake Michigan with a historic streetcar line. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
